shopify.title: Foundations
shopify.subtitle: E-commerce samjho, phir shuru karo
shopify.goal: E-commerce models samajhna aur apna niche select karna

steps.title: E-commerce models samjho
steps.details: Dropshipping, wholesale, white-label aur print-on-demand ka farq seekho. Pakistan me COD (Cash on Delivery) sab se popular model hai: customer pehle order karta hai, payment delivery par hoti hai.

steps.title: Apna niche select karo
steps.details: Ek category chuno jisme interest ho: fashion, beauty, electronics accessories, home & kitchen, ya fitness. Broad "general store" se behtar hai ek focused niche: marketing asaan hoti hai aur brand banta hai.

steps.title: Competitors research karo
steps.details: Daraz, Facebook aur Instagram par apne niche ke 10 successful stores dhoondo. Unki pricing, product photos, aur customer reviews note karo. Yehi tumhara free market research hai.

shopify.title: Store Setup
shopify.subtitle: Apna Shopify store live karo
shopify.goal: Ek professional Shopify store ready — products ke sath

steps.title: Shopify account banao
steps.details: Shopify.com par 3-day free trial start karo (phir $1/month pehle 3 months). Store ka naam apne niche se related rakho: chota, yaad rehne wala, aur .com domain ke sath.

steps.title: Theme select aur customize karo
steps.details: Free theme "Dawn" se start karo: fast aur mobile-friendly hai. Apna logo (Canva se free me banao), brand colors, aur homepage banners lagao. Mobile par check karna mat bhoolo: 80%+ traffic mobile se aata hai.

steps.title: Essential pages banao
steps.details: About Us, Contact, Shipping Policy, Return/Refund Policy, Privacy Policy aur Terms of Service: ye 6 pages lazmi hain. Inke baghair customer trust nahi karega aur Meta ads reject ho sakte hain.

steps.title: Payment aur shipping set karo
steps.details: Pakistan me COD default rakho. JazzCash/Easypaisa ke liye manual payment method add karo. Shipping rates set karo: free shipping Rs. 2,000+ orders par, warna flat Rs. 200-250.

steps.title: Winning product criteria seekho
steps.details: Acha product: masla hal kare, Rs. 1,500-4,000 price range me ho, halka ho (shipping sasti), aur emotional buying trigger kare (beauty, health, convenience, status).

steps.title: Suppliers dhoondo
steps.details: Local: Shah Alam Market (Lahore), Bolton Market (Karachi), ya China se Alibaba/1688. Start me local supplier behtar: fast delivery, COD asaan. 3-4 suppliers se rates compare karo.

steps.title: Products list karo (high-quality content ke sath)
steps.details: Har product ke liye: 5-7 achi photos (supplier se lo ya khud shoot karo), clear title, benefits-focused description (features nahi, faiday likho), aur honest pricing. Pehle 10 products list karo.

shopify.title: Store Optimization
shopify.subtitle: Visitors ko buyers me badlo
shopify.goal: Conversion rate 2%+ (har 100 visitors me se 2+ orders)

steps.title: Product pages optimize karo
steps.details: Har product page par: customer reviews section, trust badges (COD available, 7-day return), WhatsApp order button, aur related products. "Buy Now" button sab se prominent ho.

steps.title: Speed optimize karo
steps.details: Images compress karo (TinyPNG use karo), unnecessary apps hatao, aur theme ka code clean rakho. Store 3 second me load hona chahiye: har extra second 7% conversion kam karta hai.

steps.title: Abandoned cart recovery set karo
steps.details: Shopify ka built-in abandoned cart email on karo + WhatsApp par manual follow-up. Pakistan me WhatsApp follow-up se 20-30% carts recover hote hain.

steps.title: Test order karo
steps.details: Khud ek test order place karo: checkout se lekar delivery tak pura flow check karo. Jo friction mile, foran fix karo.

steps.title: Facebook/Instagram page banao
steps.details: Business page + Instagram business account. Roz 1 post: product videos, customer reviews, behind-the-scenes. Pehle 500 followers organic lao: friends, family, aur niche groups se.

steps.title: TikTok organic marketing
steps.details: Roz 1-2 short videos: product demo, unboxing, before/after. TikTok Pakistan me free reach ka best source hai. Ek viral video = 100+ orders.

steps.title: Meta ads start karo (small budget)
steps.details: Rs. 1,000/day se start karo. Pehle "Video Views" campaign se audience warm karo, phir "Sales" campaign. Ek product, ek video ad, ek audience: simple rakho. 3 din me result na aaye to ad change karo, budget nahi barhao.

steps.title: Influencer marketing try karo
steps.details: Micro-influencers (10K-50K followers) ko free product bhejo barter par. Unki story/post se pehli sales aati hain aur social proof banta hai.

shopify.title: Operations
shopify.subtitle: Orders handle karna seekho
shopify.goal: Smooth daily operations — 10+ orders/day handle karna

steps.title: Order fulfillment system banao
steps.details: Roz subah orders print karo, packing karo, aur courier book karo. TCS, Leopards, ya PostEx: rates compare karke ek select karo. Tracking number customer ko WhatsApp par bhejo.

steps.title: Customer service ka flow banao
steps.details: WhatsApp Business app use karo: quick replies (price, delivery time, return policy), catalog, aur labels (New Order, Shipped, Delivered). Fast reply = repeat customer.

steps.title: Returns handle karna seekho
steps.details: Clear return policy rakho: 7-day easy return. Return ka kharcha customer par (ya Rs. 2,500+ orders par free). Har return se seekho: product ya description me kya masla tha?

steps.title: Hisab-kitab rakho
steps.details: Simple Excel sheet: daily sales, ad spend, product cost, courier cost, profit. Har hafte review karo: kaunsa product profit de raha hai, kaunsa band karna hai.

shopify.title: Scale
shopify.subtitle: Rs. 1 lakh/month se aage
shopify.goal: Rs. 300,000+/month revenue — team aur systems ke sath

steps.title: Winning products par focus karo
steps.details: Jo 3-5 products sab se zyada bik rahe hain, unhi par ad budget lagao. Losers ko hatao. "Hero products" par bundles aur upsells banao (Buy 2 Get 1, etc.).

steps.title: Ad budget scale karo (profitably)
steps.details: Jab ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) 3x+ ho, budget 20% har 3 din me barhao. Naye audiences test karo: lookalike, broad, interest stacking. Creative har 2 hafte refresh karo.

steps.title: Team banao
steps.details: Pehli hire: packer/helper (Rs. 25-30K). Dusri: customer service rep. Teesri: video editor/content creator. Tum sirf strategy aur growth par focus karo.

steps.title: Brand banao, sirf store nahi
steps.details: Apni packaging, apna logo har parcel par, thank-you card, aur email list banao. Brand wale stores 3x zyada repeat customers lete hain.

amazon.title: Amazon Models Samjho
amazon.subtitle: Kaunsa model tumhare liye sahi hai

steps.title: Amazon ke models samjho
steps.details: Private Label (apna brand): zyada profit, zyada investment. Wholesale (dusron ke brands becho): tez start. Online Arbitrage (saste me khareed ke Amazon par becho): kam investment se shuruat. Dropshipping Amazon par risky hai: avoid karo.

steps.title: Pakistan se Amazon — reality check
steps.details: Pakistan direct seller countries me nahi hai. Tumhe US/UK ki company (LLC/LTD), US address, aur US bank account (Payoneer/Wise) chahiye hoga. Ye setup $300-500 me ho jata hai. Bina iske account ban sakta hai lekin limited rahega.

steps.title: Budget aur model final karo
steps.details: Beginners ke liye Online Arbitrage ya Wholesale best hai ($500-1,000 se start). Private Label ke liye $3,000-5,000 chahiye. Apne budget ke hisab se model choose karo aur usi par focus rakho.

steps.title: Documents tayyar karo
steps.details: Passport ya CNIC (English), bank statement (address proof), credit/debit card (international), phone number, email. Company documents (LLC) agar Private Label/Wholesale karna hai.

steps.title: Seller Central par register karo
steps.details: sellercentral.amazon.com par jao → Professional plan ($39.99/month) select karo. Saari details carefully bharo: ghalat info se account suspend ho sakta hai. Video verification call ke liye tayyar raho.

steps.title: Tax aur bank info add karo
steps.details: W-8BEN form (non-US sellers ke liye), Payoneer/Wise US bank details add karo. Ye step miss hua to payments atak jayengi.

steps.title: Research tools seekho
steps.details: Helium 10 ya Jungle Scout (paid tools): monthly searches, competition, revenue estimates dekhte hain. Free start: Amazon search bar suggestions, Best Sellers list, aur Keepa (price history) use karo.

steps.title: Product criteria apply karo
steps.details: Price $15-50, halka wazan (shipping sasta), 4+ star ratings wala niche jahan top sellers ke reviews 500 se kam hon, saal bhar demand ho (seasonal avoid karo start me).

steps.title: Competition analyze karo
steps.details: Top 10 competitors dekho: unke reviews, price, listing quality. Agar sab ke 5,000+ reviews hain to wo niche chhor do. Kamzor listing = tumhara mauqa.

steps.title: Alibaba par suppliers dhoondo
steps.details: 3-5 suppliers ko message karo: price, MOQ, sample cost pucho. Trade Assurance wala supplier chuno. Sample zaroor mangwao ($30-50): bina dekhe bara order kabhi mat do.

steps.title: Sample check karo
steps.details: Quality, packaging, size: sab check karo. Kamzor sample = supplier change karo. Achi quality hi reviews aur repeat sales layegi.

steps.title: Pehla inventory order do
steps.details: Start chota karo: 100-200 units. Shipping method: air (tez, mehnga) ya sea (sasta, 30-40 din). FBA ke liye Amazon warehouse bhejo: Amazon khud pack aur ship karega.

steps.title: Title aur bullets likho
steps.details: Title: main keyword + key features (200 characters). 5 bullet points: har ek ek faida bataye, keywords naturally use hon. Backend search terms bhi bharo (250 bytes).

steps.title: Professional images lagao
steps.details: 7 images: white background main image, lifestyle shots, infographics (size/features), comparison chart. Achi images conversion 30%+ barhati hain: ye investment hai, kharcha nahi.

steps.title: A+ Content aur Brand Registry
steps.details: Brand Registry (trademark ke sath) karwao: phir A+ Content (rich images) add karo. Ye trust barhata hai aur conversion improve karta hai.

steps.title: Amazon PPC campaigns chalao
steps.details: 3 campaign types: Auto (keywords dhoondo), Manual (exact keywords), Product targeting (competitors). Start $10-20/day se. Har 3 din me optimize karo: bekar keywords band, achon ka budget barhao.

steps.title: Pehle reviews hasil karo
steps.details: Amazon Vine program join karo (30 reviews tak). 'Request a Review' button har order par dabao. Kabhi fake reviews mat khareedo: account suspend ho jayega.

steps.title: Price strategy set karo
steps.details: Launch me thoda kam price rakho (competitors se 10-15% kam), reviews aane ke baad normal karo. Coupon (5-10% off) lagao: green badge click barhata hai.

steps.title: Dusra product launch karo
steps.details: Pehle product ka profit dusre product me lagao. Same niche me variations (size/color) ya complementary products: existing customers ko dobara becho.

steps.title: PPC optimize aur TACOS track karo
steps.details: TACOS (Total Ad Cost of Sales) 10-15% par rakho. Brand campaigns alag, competitor targeting alag. Jo keyword profit nahi de raha, use pause karo.

steps.title: International expand karo
steps.details: US me kamyab product ko UK, Canada, UAE me launch karo. Amazon ka 'Build International Listings' tool use karo: ek listing, multiple markets.

steps.title: Hisab-kitab tight rakho
steps.details: Har product ka alag P&L: product cost, shipping, Amazon fees (15% referral + FBA), PPC, returns. Net margin 25%+ hona chahiye warna product change karo.
